{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders found: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Drop QA orders
data_clean = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Drop refunded orders
data_clean = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = data_clean.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()

print("Total revenue by channel:")
print(total_revenue_by_channel)

# Extract the maximum revenue and corresponding channel
max_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel['revenue_clean'].max()
max_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue_clean'].idxmax(), 'channel']

print(f"Channel with highest revenue: {max_channel} with $ {max_revenue:,.2f}")"}
